scenario.name: writer-bee-outage
scenario.breaks: the bee node the uploader writes through, for longer than it can retry
scenario.expectation: The segment in flight is dropped and a discontinuity is armed, so the viewer meets a break in the timeline rather than a gap in the numbering. The picture should stop while nothing is being written and then resume across the discontinuity without a reload and without ending the broadcast.
